tests.name: u8string_json_type_cxx20
tests.intent: Verify that constructing a JSON value from a std::u8string results in a JSON string type under C++20.

tests.name: u8string_roundtrip_get
tests.intent: Verify that a std::u8string stored as a JSON string can be successfully read back via get<std::u8string>().

tests.name: u8string_get_to
tests.intent: Verify that get_to correctly populates an existing std::u8string variable from a JSON string.

tests.name: u8string_backward_compat_array
tests.intent: Verify that from_json still correctly reads old-style arrays of code units into a std::u8string.

tests.name: u8string_invalid_type_throw
tests.intent: Verify that calling get<std::u8string>() on a non-string/non-array JSON type throws a type_error exception.

tests.name: u8string_embedded_nul
tests.intent: Verify that a std::u8string containing embedded NUL characters round-trips correctly as a JSON string.

tests.name: u8string_in_vector_container
tests.intent: Verify that containers of std::u8string (like std::vector) convert to JSON arrays of strings rather than arrays of number arrays.

tests.name: u8string_ordered_json_behavior
tests.intent: Verify that ordered_json preserves std::u8string values as strings properly.

tests.name: u8string_view_unchanged_behavior
tests.intent: Verify that std::u8string_view still serializes as an array of code units as maintained from 3.12.0 behaviour.

tests.name: char8_t_array_unchanged_behavior
tests.intent: Verify that raw char8_t arrays still serialize as arrays of code units.

tests.name: u8string_resize_direct_access_perf
tests.intent: Verify that loading a JSON string into std::u8string via the new from_json implementation handles large contents correctly.

tests.name: u8string_adl_serializer_direct
tests.intent: Verify direct invocation of adl_serializer for std::u8string to and from json types.

tests.name: u8string_map_key_usage
tests.intent: Verify usage of std::u8string as keys or values in maps when converted to JSON structures.

tests.name: u8string_empty_string_roundtrip
tests.intent: Verify that an empty std::u8string correctly serializes to an empty JSON string and deserializes back.

tests.name: u8string_optional_support
tests.intent: Verify optional wrapping of std::u8string converts to json string correctly.

tests.name: u8string_patch_and_merge
tests.intent: Verify that JSON patch or merge operations interacting with string values handle std::u8string types seamlessly.

tests.name: u8string_pointer_access
tests.intent: Verify json_pointer lookup on objects containing std::u8string values converted to json strings.

tests.name: u8string_explicit_vector_workaround
tests.intent: Verify that the suggested migration workaround of explicitly wrapping into std::vector<char8_t> produces an array of code units.

tests.name: u8string_type_error_message
tests.intent: Verify that type_error exception thrown on invalid extraction from a boolean or object contains expected error information.

tests.name: u8string_initializer_list_assignment
tests.intent: Verify handling of std::u8string in nested initializer list constructions.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Verify that to_json correctly converts a custom allocator std::u8string via adl_serializer to a JSON string using string_t conversion.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Verify that from_json via adl_serializer correctly parses a JSON string into a std::u8string using resize and element assignment.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Verify that from_json handles an old-style array fallback inside adl_serializer for std::u8string correctly.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Verify that from_json throws type_error when given a non-string and non-array JSON type for std::u8string extraction.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Verify explicit to_json overload template invocation with basic_json and alt_string / basic_string<char8_t> types.
